## Code Elements

### Request/Response Types
- **`ExecuteRequest`** — POST /execute request body; contains Jira ticket ID, user role, target URL, execution mode, and optional credentials/guidance (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:32`)
- **`ExecuteResponse`** — POST /execute response; returns run ID, human-readable label, status, WebSocket URL, and noVNC URL (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:85`)
- **`PreviewStepsResponse`** — GET /preview-steps response; returns parsed AC steps for human review before execution (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:71`)
- **`StatusResponse`** — GET /status/{run_id} response; provides progress tracking, artifact URLs, and step counters (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:107`)
- **`CredentialCheckResponse`** — GET /ticket/{ticket_id}/credentials response; indicates email/password completeness and status (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:262`)

### Artifact Management
- **`ArtifactsInfo`** — Artifact URLs from completed runs: video_url, report_url, screenshot array (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:123`)

### Health Check
- **`HealthResponse`** — GET /health response; reports status (ok/degraded), mode, version, service checks (Jira, S3, Bedrock), uptime, active/completed run counts (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:137`)

### WebSocket Message Types
- **`WSStepMessage`** — Per-action WebSocket message after each browser step; includes step index, action type, locator, success flag, screenshot URL, LLM reasoning (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:160`)
- **`WSTerminalMessage`** — Terminal message on run completion/failure; signals client to close WebSocket, returns report/video URLs, bug count, AC step pass rate (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:175`)
- **`WSScreenshotMessage`** — Live browser screenshot update after each planner iteration; carries base64 PNG, step progress (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:194`)
- **`WSThinkingMessage`** — LLM reasoning message before each step executes; text content for live thinking panel (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:207`)
- **`WSTriageMessage`** — Failure analysis on FAILED runs; per-step classification (product_bug/agent_issue/passed), confidence, reason, Jira wiki-markup comment (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:219`)
- **`WSHumanTakeoverMessage`** — Human takeover notification; stuck AC step, error message, step index (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:238`)
- **`WSMessage`** — Union type for all WebSocket messages (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:250`)

### Enums & Type Aliases
- **`ExecutionMode`** — `"interactive" | "headless"` (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:277`)
- **`RunStatus`** — `"queued" | "running" | "completed" | "failed"` (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:280`)
- **`RoleKey`** — Union of 9 vProMedia user roles: account_executive, sales_manager, sales_assistant, production_manager, producer, gm_gsm, dubber, digital_director, vpromotions_user (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:286`)

### Constants & Lookup Tables

- **`API_BASE_URL`** — Backend API base URL; reads from VITE_API_URL env var, defaults to http://localhost:8000 (`frontend/src/types/index.ts:324`)
